species.habitat_substrate: Damp limestone walls and sulfur drainage adits
species.medicinal_extract: Mild antiseptic poultice; natural luciferase enzyme for cold lighting lanterns
species.botanist_field_notes: Emits a steady, ethereal cyan luminescence through ATP-luciferase reaction fueled by pyrite seepage. We line the residential corridor floors with it so dwellers can walk safely without burning precious candles.

species.habitat_substrate: Decomposing pine mine timbers and soaked peat beds
species.medicinal_extract: High beta-glucan immune stimulant; lovastatin precursor
species.botanist_field_notes: Thrives on damp sawdust and rotting pine lagging. Produces meaty grey flushes every two weeks. When simmered with fried lard and salt, provides the protein that keeps our miners alive.

species.habitat_substrate: Pyritic shale crevices near hot steam fissures
species.medicinal_extract: Concentrated oxalic and styptic acids for surgical cauterization
species.botanist_field_notes: Brilliant ruby red goblet-shaped cups growing in clusters near geothermal steam vents. Inedible and acidic, but Dr. Vel uses crushed dried cups to stop capillary hemorrhages during field surgeries.

species.habitat_substrate: Fermenting rye mash and potato peel slurries
species.medicinal_extract: Massive Vitamin B-complex complex; thiamine and riboflavin supplement
species.botanist_field_notes: A wild sourdough yeast isolated from pre-war flour sacks on Day 4. Extremely resilient to low temperatures (ferments vigorously at 12°C). Oxana feeds it daily with potato starch to raise our sourdough loaves.

species.habitat_substrate: Bat guano deposits and limestone karst floors
species.medicinal_extract: Dark permanent pigment for document ink and tally slates
species.botanist_field_notes: Sprouts in complete darkness within hours after a rock tremor. The delicate white caps auto-digest into a rich, pitch-black liquid. Sister Mara boils this ink to record names in the Standing Record ledger.

species.habitat_substrate: Hydroponic peat troughs inoculated with dwarf willow roots
species.medicinal_extract: Vitamin D2 and natural antiparasitic compounds
species.botanist_field_notes: Deep apricot-yellow trumpets with a rich peppery fragrance. Requires symbiotic living willow root seedlings. Eating five chanterelles a week completely cures winter rickets in the children.

species.habitat_substrate: Dry granite roof strata in cold upper intake shafts
species.medicinal_extract: Usnic acid antibiotic broth; wound dressing fiber
species.botanist_field_notes: Hangs like gray horsehair from cold rock ceilings. Rich in usnic acid, an incredible broad-spectrum natural antibiotic. Sonya boils it into a bitter tea to treat dweller chest infections and pneumonia.

species.habitat_substrate: Parasitized subterranean darkling beetles in coal adits
species.medicinal_extract: Potent stimulant and pulmonary vasodilator (cordycepin)
species.botanist_field_notes: Grows out of the head shells of dead beetles in the coal tunnels. Harvesting spores requires charcoal dust masks. An extract of the orange fruiting horns keeps exhausted airlock sentries awake during blizzard watches.

species.habitat_substrate: Uraniferous black slate crevices on Sub-Level 6
species.medicinal_extract: Radiotrophic fungal melanin for radiation-shielding polymer coatings
species.botanist_field_notes: Antler-shaped branching coral fungus of intense violet hue. Absorbs gamma radiation through specialized dense melanin pigments. Ilya extracts this melanin to formulate radiation-resistant paint for surface hazmat helmets.

species.habitat_substrate: Dolomite silt beds enriched with bone meal
species.medicinal_extract: Universal dry surgical hemostatic powder
species.botanist_field_notes: Grows up to 30cm across like a white leather bowling ball. When young, sliced and fried like breaded cutlets. When mature, the trillions of dry brown spores instantly clot arterial bleeding when dusted onto wounds.

species.habitat_substrate: Shallow galvanized water troughs under LED scrap strips
species.medicinal_extract: Dense bio-lipid oil for smokeless wick lamps and machine lubrication
species.botanist_field_notes: Emerald green slime cultured in shallow pans. Pressed through cotton gauze to yield thick, odorless green oil. Burns cleanly in tin cans without choking the ventilation blowers with soot.

species.habitat_substrate: Dead spruce support headers in abandoned drift adits
species.medicinal_extract: Concentrated oak tannins for leather boot curing; antifungal wood wash
species.botanist_field_notes: Hard as iron wood. Requires a steel saw to cut from timbers. Yuri the cobbler boils the shavings to produce vegetable tanning liquor for softening cured dog and wolf hides into winter boot uppers.

species.habitat_substrate: Waterlogged pine lagging in cold drainage shafts
species.medicinal_extract: Foxfire luminous thread; early moisture alarm indicator
species.botanist_field_notes: Forms thick black shoestring cords (rhizomorphs) beneath the bark. In absolute darkness, glowing yellow-green light pulses along the strands. Warns miners of hidden water leaks before timber rot occurs.

species.habitat_substrate: Damp rye grain stores during humidity leaks
species.medicinal_extract: Potent ergotamine alkaloid for postpartum uterine contraction; lethal neurotoxin
species.botanist_field_notes: The great terror of the grain silos. Black horn-like sclerotia growing on damp rye spikes. Causes gangrenous ergotism and violent convulsions if milled into flour. Dr. Sonya harvests minute quantities for maternity care.

species.habitat_substrate: Peat soil boxes near chilled airlock intake ducts (-2°C to 4°C)
species.medicinal_extract: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C); natural scurvy preventative
species.botanist_field_notes: Elena bred this strain to thrive in near-freezing draft vestibules. Thick ruby-red stalks packed with natural tart Vitamin C. Stewed with honey, completely eradicated scurvy across our first three winters.

species.habitat_substrate: Permian rock salt dome walls on Sub-Level 7
species.medicinal_extract: Beta-carotene and astaxanthin antioxidant carotenoids
species.botanist_field_notes: Stains the white rock salt crystals a brilliant salmon pink. Synthesizes dense astaxanthin antioxidants to protect against extreme osmotic pressure. Dried flakes are ground into salt seasoning for eye health.

species.habitat_substrate: Birch log inoculations in cool, high-humidity crypt adits
species.medicinal_extract: Hericenones and erinacines stimulating nerve growth factor (NGF)
species.botanist_field_notes: Cascades of white icicle spines hanging from birch logs. Tastes remarkably like butter-poached lobster when pan-fried. Dr. Sonya prescribes it to dwellers suffering memory fog and blast concussions.

species.habitat_substrate: Buried willow root mycorrhizal peat beds at 40cm depth
species.medicinal_extract: Intense aromatic pheromones; supreme luxury morale booster
species.botanist_field_notes: Warty black truffles unearthed with the help of trained shelter dogs. The overpowering earthy musk elevates boiled turnip soup into a banquet. Worth its weight in silver ammunition on the trade road.

species.habitat_substrate: Toxic heavy metal tailing sumps beneath the machine shop
species.medicinal_extract: Bio-accumulated mercury and lead extraction via pyrolytic burning
species.botanist_field_notes: Vivid saffron-orange mycelial mats that absorb toxic mercury, lead, and cadmium ions from workshop runoff water. Ilya collects and burns the dry mats in closed retorts to recover pure liquid mercury for barometers.

species.habitat_substrate: Waste water settling lagoons in the lower hydraulic sump
species.medicinal_extract: Starchy rhizome flour, wound dressing fluff, and woven sleep mats
species.botanist_field_notes: Thrives in greywater filtration tanks. The rhizomes yield pure edible starch; the brown seedheads provide silky waterproof down for winter jacket insulation and mattress ticking.

species.habitat_substrate: Inoculated birch logs in refrigerated cold-air drifts
species.medicinal_extract: High betulinic acid antioxidant tonic; black lung expectorant
species.botanist_field_notes: Charred black crust resembling burnt charcoal on birch trunks. Grated and steeped into dark earthy tea. Clears coal dust and soot from the bronchial tubes of stoker Nadia and the mining crews.

species.habitat_substrate: Seeping methane fissure roofs in Coal Seam Alpha
species.medicinal_extract: Single-cell microbial protein biomass for poultry and rabbit feed
species.botanist_field_notes: Slimy crimson biofilm coating methane fissure roofs. Consumes explosive fire-damp gas (CH4) and converts it into safe carbon dioxide and protein-rich bacterial meal for our bunker rabbit hutches.

species.habitat_substrate: Deep gravel aeration basins with flowing artesian water
species.medicinal_extract: Pure salicin glycoside; natural organic aspirin for pain and fever
species.botanist_field_notes: Elena maintains six dwarf willow trees in gravel aeration beds. Stripping the inner white bark yields natural aspirin that suppresses fevers, reduces surgical inflammation, and prevents blood clots.

species.habitat_substrate: Living mountain soil bed under the Sunken Atrium skylight
species.medicinal_extract: Sweet golden winter apples; living emblem of human survival and rebirth
species.botanist_field_notes: Planted from the single seed in Sonya's grandfather's walnut box on Day 3650. The roots drank the clean artesian dolomite water; the leaves unfurled under genuine morning sunlight. Our children tasted their first fresh apple. We have returned to the world.
